tei:div.tei:p: And Thou hast made known to us, O Lord our God, Thy righteous judgments and taught us to carry out the statutes of Thy will and Thou hast given us, O Lord our God, upright judgments and laws of truth, good statutes and commandments and Thou hast allotted us seasons of delight and times of sanctity and festivals of generosity. Thou hast let us inherit the sanctity of the Sabbath and the glory of the festival and the celebration of the Feast. Thou hast distinguished, O Lord our God, between sacred and profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the peoples, between the seventh day and the six days of work. Between the sanctity of the Sabbath and the sanctity of the festival hast Thou distinguished and the seventh day hast Thou sanctified apart from the six days of work. Thou hast distinguished and sanctified Thy people Israel through Thine own holiness.
